requirements.quote:
Whenever a diagram shows a



Mockapetris                                                     [Page 8]


RFC 1035        Domain Implementation and Specification    November 1987


group of octets, the order of transmission of those octets is the normal
order in which they are read in English.
requirements.condition: When transmitting a group of octets shown in a diagram in this specification.
requirements.required_behavior: Transmit octets in diagram reading order: from left to right within each row, and from the top row to the bottom row.
requirements.why_checkable: The emitted byte sequence can be compared with the diagram positions of the encoded octets.

requirements.quote:
Whenever an octet represents a numeric quantity, the left most bit in
the diagram is the high order or most significant bit.  That is, the bit
labeled 0 is the most significant bit.
requirements.condition: When an octet represents a numeric quantity.
requirements.required_behavior: Interpret the leftmost diagram bit, labeled 0, as the most significant bit of the octet.
requirements.why_checkable: Numeric octet encoding and decoding can be checked for the weight assigned to bit 0.

requirements.quote:
Similarly, whenever a multi-octet field represents a numeric quantity
the left most bit of the whole field is the most significant bit.
requirements.condition: When a multi-octet field represents a numeric quantity.
requirements.required_behavior: Interpret the leftmost bit of the whole field as its most significant bit.
requirements.why_checkable: The field encoder and decoder can be checked for the numeric weight of the leftmost field bit.

requirements.quote:
Similarly, whenever a multi-octet field represents a numeric quantity
the left most bit of the whole field is the most significant bit.  When
a multi-octet quantity is transmitted the most significant octet is
transmitted first.
requirements.condition: When transmitting a multi-octet numeric quantity.
requirements.required_behavior: Transmit the most significant octet first.
requirements.why_checkable: The wire order of a multi-octet numeric value can be checked against its octet significance.
